role: Analytics Engineer, Assistant Vice President, State Street Investment Management
responsibilities: Focusing on impactful analyses that will significantly contribute to business objectives, the role will consist of contributing across the full analytical lifecycle, including data modelling and the development and maintenance of Tableau dashboards and reports that deliver clear, timely insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders

Designing, implementing, and maintaining high-quality ETL and Lakehouse pipelines across Databricks and Amazon Redshift to support the Single Source of Truth (SSOT) project by centralizing and integrating disparate datasets (e.g. Salesforce/CRM, holdings and finance data) into a scalable analytical infrastructure

Collaborating with Strategy and other business and technology stakeholders to understand key business and strategy questions, and producing analytical products that directly support commercial and strategic objectives

Develop and enhance enterprise-grade Tableau dashboards that communicate trends, drivers, and performance clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ensure dashboards meet standards for performance, usability, and interpretability
Contribute to design decisions around data freshness, transformation layers, and analytical layer. Proactively identify data quality issues and partner with upstream teams to resolve them
Work closely with the local VP to support team management and strategic planning

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Experience owning production reliability, validation and reconciliation against source systems, timely resolution of failures and clear documentation
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Quality and control language ("high-quality ETL", "validation and reconciliation", "formal SDLC and change-management processes") outweighs the single "fast-moving environments" phrase.
evidence.domain_risk: centralizing and integrating disparate datasets (e.g. Salesforce/CRM, holdings and finance data) into a scalable analytical infrastructure
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Asset management is a default-high sector, but the work serves strategy and commercial reporting with no regulatory or financial-reporting language, so the tie-breaker gives moderate.
evidence.collaboration_width: Strategy; Capital Markets; Technology; IT and engineering teams
evidence.data_team_maturity: Experience partnering closely with IT and engineering teams to move analytical solutions through formal SDLC and change-management processes
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A dedicated business unit with reporting, data infrastructure and sales enablement functions, formal SDLC and an enterprise SSOT project mark an established, specialised function.
evidence.jd_authorship: Designing, implementing, and maintaining high-quality ETL and Lakehouse pipelines across Databricks and Amazon Redshift to support the Single Source of Truth (SSOT) project
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Bullets name the platforms, the SSOT project and the source datasets, so the actual work is clear.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: producing analytical products that directly support commercial and strategic objectives
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The primary audience is strategy and commercial teams, with CRM data and sales enablement central to the work.
evidence.autonomy_level: Contribute to design decisions around data freshness, transformation layers, and analytical layer.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role is "a hands-on, technical position" that contributes to design and supports the VP, rather than setting direction.
evidence.ai_role: Exposure to AI-supported analytics or agent design patterns such as RAG, orchestration and routing
evidence.ai_role_explanation: Agent design patterns such as RAG are a preferred qualification, which points to building systems AI runs on, though only as a nice-to-have.
evidence.testing_framing: Proactively identify data quality issues and partner with upstream teams to resolve them
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Finding and resolving data quality issues is a responsibility, backed by a requirement for "owning production reliability, validation and reconciliation".
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Experience owning production reliability, validation and reconciliation against source systems, timely resolution of failures
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The fear is pipeline failures and unreconciled data, framed as operational reliability secondary to delivering dashboards and pipelines.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Develop and enhance enterprise-grade Tableau dashboards
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Building the new SSOT infrastructure sits alongside enhancing and maintaining existing dashboards and pipelines.
evidence.loss_aversion: Experience owning production reliability, validation and reconciliation against source systems — reliability is a stated requirement, not the role's main framing.
